optimizedDescription.value: Centralize graph CLI config/bootstrap/provider wiring via @specd/sdk; CLI retains signals, exits, formatted failures.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph CLI Context
## Rules
- `resolveGraphCliContext`: configured mode via `resolveCliContext` / `openSpecdHost`; platform types ONLY from `@specd/sdk` re-exports.
- Configured (`--config` or discovery): use resolved config project root; no VCS required; VCS root absent when undetected, provider health surfaces unavailable VCS without rejecting command.
- Bootstrap (`--path` / no-config fallback): REQUIRE resolved VCS root; synthetic single-workspace project rooted at VCS root.
- `withProvider` (`packages/cli/src/commands/graph/with-provider.ts`): build `SdkHostContext` from resolved config + kernel (when available); open/close provider via `withOpenGraphProvider` from `@specd/sdk`.
- `withProvider` retains format-aware fatal error reporting pre-open; MUST NOT install graph-store-specific signal handlers or force `process.exit(0)` for backend-native threads; cleanup via SDK lifecycle; normal completion returns to CLI runtime.
- `search`, `hotspots`, `impact`, `stats`: shared provider lifecycle via `withProvider`; context via shared graph CLI context, never backend-specific host bootstrap/shutdown.
- `graph index`: delegate to `runIndexProjectGraph` (`@specd/sdk`); no long-lived `withProvider`; worker subprocess indexes in isolation.
- Host symbols: `@specd/sdk` via this module or `cli:host-context`.
- No host-managed pre-open lock probes; availability errors incl. indexing-busy surfaced by SDK-owned opened provider lifecycle.
## Constraints
- SDK owns provider lifecycle; CLI owns bootstrap, signals, exit, error presentation.
